ISS-access.name: Login and password failures
ISS-access.summary: Users cannot get into their accounts because the password is rejected and ads are excessive.

ISS-billing.name: Premium paywall restricting core features
ISS-billing.summary: Recent updates locked skipping, song choice, and playback behind Premium, prompting frustration and cancellations.

ISS-catalog.name: Missing lyrics and song catalog gaps
ISS-catalog.summary: Lyrics often fail to appear and many songs, including some genres, are unavailable or poorly recommended.

ISS-downloads.name: Offline downloads not working
ISS-downloads.summary: Offline mode fails to work and background downloading gets stuck until the app is reopened.

ISS-other.name: General dissatisfaction with recent update
ISS-other.summary: Users broadly describe the app as bad or useless after the latest update, with vague complaints about restrictions.

ISS-playback.name: Playback crashes, stalls, and connectivity errors
ISS-playback.summary: The app crashes or stays on the loading screen, fails to play songs via assistant, stops mid-track, and has Wi-Fi connection problems.

ISS-usability.name: Frequent ads and restrictive skip limits
ISS-usability.summary: Ads appear every song or two and skip limits plus random playlist shuffling frustrate users who want simple control.
